headline: BMO is introducing AI Agent Assist for credit card clients
body: Finextra reports that BMO is introducing AI Agent Assist to help clients get faster answers and resolutions when they contact BMO's Virtual Connect contact centre about their credit card transactions.
note: The tool sits in the contact centre, the channel where clients ask about credit card transactions, and that makes it a practical test of AI in service work.
